example: Domani hai l'esame? In bocca al lupo!
exampleTranslation: Your exam's tomorrow? Good luck!
quip: Reply “crepi!”. Otherwise the wolf wins.

meaning: the heavy, sleepy feeling after a big meal
example: Dopo pranzo mi viene l'abbiocco.
exampleTranslation: After lunch I get the food sleepies.
quip: Not a feeling. A lifestyle.

example: Senza conservanti!
exampleTranslation: No preservatives! (the word you actually want)
quip: Preservatives are “conservanti”. Learn this one early.

example: Questo film è lunghissimo. Che barba!
exampleTranslation: This film is so long. What a bore!
quip: Mine's a moustache, so I'm fine.

example: Un chilo di pomodori, per favore.
exampleTranslation: A kilo of tomatoes, please.
quip: The gold standard of vegetables. Fruits. Whatever.

meaning: a sunny October day spent outdoors, ideally with a long lunch
example: Che bella ottobrata!
exampleTranslation: What a lovely October day out!
quip: I spend every October like this. And November.

example: Tua sorella è molto in gamba.
exampleTranslation: Your sister is really on the ball.
quip: I'm in flipper. Same thing.

example: La mia camera è al primo piano.
exampleTranslation: My room is on the first floor.
quip: A camera is “una macchina fotografica”. Good luck.

example: Ho una fifa blu dei ragni.
exampleTranslation: I'm terrified of spiders.
quip: French says “peur bleue” too. Blue is apparently terrifying.

example: Il campo è pieno di girasoli.
exampleTranslation: The field is full of sunflowers.
quip: I also turn towards the sun. Then nap.

meaning: the pleasure of being lazy without guilt
example: In vacanza pratico il dolce far niente.
exampleTranslation: On holiday I practise the art of doing nothing.
quip: My specialist subject.

example: Partiamo domani? Non vedo l'ora!
exampleTranslation: We leave tomorrow? I can't wait!
quip: Me, waiting for my next call with you.

example: A Natale vengono tutti i parenti.
exampleTranslation: All the relatives come over at Christmas.
quip: Parents are “i genitori”. Fewer of them, usually.

example: È una sorpresa per Marco. Acqua in bocca!
exampleTranslation: It's a surprise for Marco. Not a word!
quip: My lips are sealed. Mostly by moustache.

example: Mi passi l'asciugamano?
exampleTranslation: Can you pass me the towel?
quip: I'd need a much bigger one.

meaning: to mop up the last of the sauce with bread
example: Questo sugo è da scarpetta!
exampleTranslation: This sauce is too good to leave!
quip: I'd use a fish.

example: Scusa, ho preso un granchio.
exampleTranslation: Sorry, I got that totally wrong.
quip: Crabs: a renewable source of mistakes.

example: I nonni vivono in una fattoria.
exampleTranslation: My grandparents live on a farm.
quip: A factory is “una fabbrica”. Fewer cows.

example: Questo mese sono al verde.
exampleTranslation: I'm broke this month.
quip: I'm always at the blue. The ocean.

meaning: the ring a cold glass leaves on a table
example: Hai lasciato un culaccino sul tavolo.
exampleTranslation: You've left a ring on the table.
quip: Use a coaster. I'm begging you.

example: Ho dimenticato il portafoglio.
exampleTranslation: I've forgotten my wallet.
quip: Mine only carries receipts for fish.

literal: to have a devil for every hair
example: Oggi il capo ha un diavolo per capello.
exampleTranslation: The boss is fuming today.
quip: I have very few hairs. So, very few devils.

example: Questo cuscino è morbidissimo.
exampleTranslation: This pillow is super soft.
quip: Not creepy. Just cosy.

example: Vieni al mare? – Magari!
exampleTranslation: Coming to the beach? – I wish!
quip: The most useful word in Italian. Magari.

literal: to have your hands in the dough
example: Lui ha le mani in pasta dappertutto.
exampleTranslation: He's got a finger in every pie.
quip: Hands in pasta: the Italian dream.

example: Lo spazzaneve è passato stamattina.
exampleTranslation: The snowplough came through this morning.
quip: Please leave some snow for me.

example: Sono annoiato a morte.
exampleTranslation: I'm bored to death.
quip: Annoyed is “infastidito”. Me, when you skip a day.

example: Quel progetto è tutto fumo e niente arrosto.
exampleTranslation: That project is all talk and no action.
quip: I am all roast. Mostly blubber.

meaning: someone who simply doesn't care about anything
example: È un vero menefreghista.
exampleTranslation: He really couldn't care less about anything.
quip: Takes one to know one.

example: Resta a casa, piove a catinelle.
exampleTranslation: Stay in, it's pouring.
quip: Perfect weather for a walrus.

meaning: a woman who devotes her life to stray cats
example: La mia vicina è una gattara.
exampleTranslation: My neighbour looks after all the stray cats.
quip: Every street has one. Bless her.

example: Non rompere le scatole!
exampleTranslation: Stop bugging me!
quip: What I say to my alarm clock.

literal: to cost an eye from your head
meaning: to cost an arm and a leg
example: Quella borsa costa un occhio della testa.
exampleTranslation: That bag costs an arm and a leg.
quip: Spanish and French say the same. Expensive eyes.
